checks.note: Authentication page confirms personal V2 token in Authorization header at api.monday.com/v2. OAuth page confirms auth.monday.com/oauth2/authorize and /token for apps, plus a newer OAuth 2.1 with expiring tokens. The cited auth URL itself does not mention OAuth, so the OAuth page is the better evidence for that part.

Rate-limits page: Free 200/day, with a paid API add-on to raise it. It also calls the API a free feature across all plans. The authentication page confirms a free developer account. Plan tiers are not stated on the Basics page, but the rate-limits page covers it. No app review was found for personal-token use.

GraphQL is confirmed as the only API described, with one endpoint and a schema at /v2/get_schema. The pages fetched give no object list, so 'broad' is inferred and cannot be confirmed from the pages fetched.

The MCP docs page lists the mondaycom/monday-ai GitHub repo, runs locally via npx @mondaydotcomorg/monday-api-mcp, and is labeled Beta. It is hosted in vendor docs under the mondaycom org, so it is vendor-published. The page does not use the word 'official'.
ready_with_caveats is consistent with the verified facts: self-serve token, 200 calls/day on Free, GraphQL only, MCP in beta. The 'breadth inferred' caveat is correct.

corrected.one_liner: Cloud work-management platform for boards, items, projects, and workflows, with CRM and service products built on the same platform.
corrected.auth_notes: Personal V2 API token goes in the Authorization header to https://api.monday.com/v2. It acts as the user. OAuth2 for apps: auth.monday.com/oauth2/authorize and /token (legacy tokens do not expire). A newer OAuth 2.1 flow adds expiring access tokens, refresh tokens and revocation. Guests cannot use personal API keys but can use OAuth.
corrected.access_notes: Personal token is available from the Developers section of any account. A free developer account is available for testing. The API is described as a free feature across all plans. Daily call caps: Free 200, Standard/Basic 1,000, Pro/Trial 10,000, Enterprise 25,000. A paid API add-on can raise the cap. Marketplace app review requirements were not verified.
corrected.blocker: Free plan is limited to 200 API calls/day; higher limits need a higher plan or a paid add-on. MCP server is labeled Beta and runs locally. Breadth is inferred from the GraphQL schema and examples, not from a full object list. Marketplace distribution review requirements are unconfirmed.
